Definition: from λικμός, the equivalent of λίκνον (a winnowing fan or basket); to winnow, i.e. (by analogy), to triturate:--grind to powder.
BiblicalUsage: likmáō means grind to powder, and its few appearances are all worth reading. In Luke 20:18, "it will grind him to powder."; and in Matthew 21:44, "it will grind him to powder.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the stone grinds to powder whoever it falls on — fall on it and be broken, or let it fall on you and be ground.
